subject: SIG intake — propose slot + evidence checklist
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — propose slot + evidence checklist

Hi Alex —

Thanks for reaching out about the SIG/CAIQ intake. We'd like to get a 45-minute working session on the calendar to walk through the questionnaire and align on evidence handoff. Proposed agenda:
- Quick intros (5m)
- CAIQ sections we'll cover and owners (10m)
- Evidence handoff: logging, encryption/KMS, network diagram, data residency (20m)
- Next steps & timeline (10m)

Are you available any of these slots (all PDT):
- Thu Sep 10, 9:00–9:45am
- Thu Sep 10, 11:30–12:15pm
- Fri Sep 11, 8:00–8:45am

I'll attach a fillable CAIQ Excel and a short SOC 2 bridge doc ahead of the call so your security team can pre-populate where convenient. If you have any pre-call questions, drop them in reply.

Thanks,
Priyom
(Enterprise Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: CAIQ-Helio-fillable.xlsx, SOC2-bridge-notes.pdf
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@heliogene.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <sam.li@heliogene.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — propose slot + evidence checklist

Priyom — thanks for the quick note and proposed agenda. Thu Sep 10 works for us; 11:30am–12:15pm PDT is ideal.

Two quick pre-call asks so we can prep the right folks:
1) Can you confirm whether the intake call will include a short review of your Private deployment options (VPC/on‑prem) and what evidence we should expect for KMS/HSM? Our infra lead wants to ensure the right SMEs join.
2) We maintain detailed logging in a third‑party log store — will a sample export (anonymized) be acceptable or do you need live access?

I can bring Samantha (infra/security ops) and our compliance manager if that helps. We'll try to pre-fill the CAIQ but appreciate the docs in advance.

—Alex
Director of Security, HelioGene
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@heliogene.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — propose slot + evidence checklist

Great — locking Thu Sep 10, 11:30–12:15pm PDT on our side. Calendar invite to follow. Attaching the fillable CAIQ and SOC2 bridge now; please share the file back when you have prefill notes.

Quick answers to your two asks:
1) We will review Private deployment variants briefly. For KMS/HSM evidence, the typical artifacts we look for are: key rotation policy, KMS access control list (roles), and a screenshot/export of key usage logs. If you use a customer-managed KMS, having an architecture diagram noting where keys are stored helps.
2) An anonymized sample log export is acceptable for initial validation. For deeper telemetry review later we may request a time‑boxed access path or a zipped log export. Marissa will follow up on exact log fields we prefer.

Agenda/owners for the call:
- Intro & objectives — Priyom (Redwood) / Alex (HelioGene)
- CAIQ walkthrough (selected controls) — Rishi (Redwood) / Samantha (HelioGene)
- Evidence types & timeline (logs, network diagram, KMS artifacts) — Marissa (Redwood)
- Next steps & doc upload instructions — Priyom

See attachments: CAIQ-Helio-fillable.xlsx, SOC2-bridge-notes.pdf. We'll also include a short sample-logs-readme.txt that lists preferred columns and anonymization guidance.

Thanks — looking forward,
Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@heliogene.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — propose slot + evidence checklist

Quick technical notes from my side (so the HelioGene infra team can prep):
- Logging: a CSV/NDJSON sample with timestamps, request_id, user_id (anonymized), event_type, resource, and result_code is ideal. Please redact or hash any PII. Sample-logs-readme.txt attached explains preferred fields and a small script we use to verify schema.
- Network diagram: a single-page diagram showing VPC/subnet boundaries, NAT/IGW, ingress points and firewall/routing rules is sufficient for the intake. We don't need full ACLs at this stage.
- KMS: if you are using a cloud KMS (AWS KMS, Google KMS, Azure Key Vault) a screenshot of key policy and a short statement of rotation cadence is fine. If HSM/on‑prem, please note CA certs and attestations available.
- Retention & backup: please have a short bulleted retention policy (logs, backups, snapshots) — we'll map that to the CAIQ questions on retention and deletion.

If you can drop the anonymized log sample + the network diagram into the shared folder before the call it will speed the session. Link to upload in invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
(Security & Controls)
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@heliogene.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Li <sam.li@heliogene.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake — propose slot + evidence checklist

Confirmed — we'll join Thu 11:30am PDT. I'll bring Samantha (infra) and our compliance manager.

Pre-call deliverables we'll upload to the shared folder by EOD:
- anonymized_log_sample.ndjson (matches fields in sample-logs-readme.txt)
- heliogene-network-diagram.png
- short KMS statement.txt (rotation cadence and key policy location)

One clarifying question for the agenda: can we allocate ~10 minutes to discuss fallback model variants and data residency implications for Dedicated vs Hosted? That's an internal product question relevant to our risk assessment.

Appreciate the guidance — see you on the call.

—Alex
